reviews.text: Amazing service here, my puppy Lambi is so happy and comfortable here, everyone so friendly and helpful here, we love it!!!
My dog… is not an easy dog. This is the only place I bring him and they take fantastic care of my lil traumatized boy. We moved and still drive hours to come here for care!
We’ve always had good experiences with Dr.Jo.
This place cares greatly for my dog ! Great care and great customer service as well. My dog has been the best health with them.

This was SheaCreme’s first Vet visit here and I truly appreciate the staff for sharing so much great information about my new pup. Thanks guys! I am excited for Shea and can’t wait to bring her back for her next visit.
Good experience for having international travel documents here!

I had a great experience at this clinic! The staff and veterinarian were very kind, patient, and professional throughout the entire process. They answered all of my questions carefully and made sure my cat was comfortable during the examination.

Since I’m traveling internationally with my cat, they also took the time to discuss the airline requirements and wanted to make sure everything would be in order before issuing the health certificate. I really appreciated how thorough and responsible they were.

Thank you for taking such good care of my cat. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy veterinary team!

5 stars are not enough. Absolutely everyone that works here are extremely kind ,caring, understanding and professional. Having to bring one of your lil loved ones to the doctors can be very upsetting for both pet and owner. It's 100% stress free here. As soon as you walk in you are greeted by a kind smiling face" Nayeli"and then there is" Ashley "as you go into a exam room and the way she interacts with your pet is a total delight . THANK YOU ,  KITTY LUE
Very good hospital
We’ve taken our dogs and cats for years , and are always satisfied. They have great availability, answer everything we ask, and always give the most options for us to choose from. Def recommend
Great experience. Got a same day appointment and solve my international health certificate problems and concerns.
Loved visiting here. The scenery was beautiful. Will definitely visit again.
The doctor at this hospital, Dr. Huang, is incredibly professional, the nurses are also wonderful, the dogs are very patient, and the overall hospital environment is quite pleasant.
Great staff
The receptionist is not interested in making appointments. She did everything she could to dissuade me from making one.

We brought our dog Mocha here for an export health check, and the experience was excellent. The team was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and experienced with international pet travel requirements. They carefully explained the entire process and made sure all the paperwork and health checks were done correctly.

Traveling internationally with a pet can be stressful, but the staff made everything smooth and reassuring. They were also very gentle and caring with Mocha, which we truly appreciated.

Highly recommend this animal hospital for anyone who needs export health certificates or travel documentation for their pets.

Doctor Jo and team were kind, professional and considerate of our time. Very easy to make an appointment, and clear communication of expected costs with the treatments. My cat was feeling very shy with coming here for the first time, with new smells and sounds. But he was in good hands with the friendly staff members.

I have been coming to this place for 5 years since my dogs were puppies. I feel confident taking my dogs. I have taken them to other vets but I like this place the most. This place is clean and staffs and doctors are very nice all the time. The wait time before the doctor comes to the consulting room is a little bit long but I understand as healthcare facilities always takes time as they are taking good and thorough care of their clients. I have been recommending my dog parents to this place several times already and they liked it too. There is no parking fee as they give validation (another fact I like about). I think I will continue to visit.
This is a such a family type of environment in here. My three cats were treated with high professionalism, vets showed gentle and caring approach. Prices don’t bite. Thank you team
What a great experience Roy pleasant staff and my dog seem to enjoy it

Been bringing my dogs here for years and always a good experience.  My dogs enjoy interacting with everyone here and have never had a bad experience here and actually enjoy coming here. They've been great with helping my dog with his allergies as well.
I've known this place since 2021 and I can say with certainty that I'm delighted. Their patience and dedication, and the importance they place on my furry friends, are truly wonderful. 🥰 …

The dogtor seems very nice and the staff are very nice as well. Prices aren't sky high and I like their flexibility when it comes to scheduling.
Amazing experience at the hospital. Great vets and care for our dog

We had a great visit to Grand Park Animal Hospital with our dogs, Teddy and Ollie. As always, the staff was friendly, professional, and made us feel very welcome. Teddy is always calm and easygoing, and the team treated him with the same warmth and care they always do.

This visit was especially important for Ollie, who came in for his second round of puppy shots. The staff handled him so gently and made sure he was comfortable throughout the process. They took the time to answer all our puppy-related questions and gave us helpful guidance moving forward.

The clinic was clean and organized, and the overall atmosphere was calm and reassuring. It’s clear that everyone there truly cares about the well-being of the animals.

Highly recommend!
Amazing doctor and nurses! They were gentle and took great care of my puppy. Will definitely return.

I enjoyed our visit from start to finish. Sharon, David and the Dr were very attentive and welcoming. They even fit us in on short notice. They gave us some ease regarding our concerns. I would recommend this office to anyone.

This veterinarian has been our main go to with our new dog. They absolutely take great care of you, the doctors are skilled and the front desk is always very kind. Special shout out to Sharon who is always very nice to us.

I've had a great experience at Grand Park Animal Hospital! The staff is incredibly kind, patient, and knowledgeable. First, I want to sincerely thank all the staff and the doctor for always providing excellent care for my dog. Every time I visit, I receive great customer service. I truly appreciate how well they treat my dog and the care they show whenever he needs help. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality care and reliable results for their pet. They offer services like vaccinations, medications, exams, and other treatments your pet may need.

This review is long overdue. I’ve been coming here for a few years and this place has always been reliable. I’m always been able to get appointments for my dog quickly so I’ve been happy about that. That staff is always friendly and professional. I have not had a bad experience here before. Thank you Grand Park Animal Hospital!
They have been very sweet with my cats. They really helpful and have answered and explained really well when I have questions.

I have been a customer for over 18 months. This is a wonderful place, filled with great people who offer great customer service for you and your pets. I am extremely grateful for all they do for my pets and I.

We’ve been coming here for 5 years and they’ve always given my baby the best care. Kind, professional, and full of good energy, so grateful for this team!

Please keep your prices as they are, that way I can continue coming back 💖 thanks so much

This place is awful.

I still remember my first visit, they gave me an insanely high estimate. But I went ahead with it anyway because my stray cat really needed treatment due to tapeworms and fleas.

After that, every visit was just okay. The doctor was actually kind, but honestly didn’t feel very professional. I once drove nearly an hour to get there, and they still charged an examination fee, even though they didn’t really examine my cat. They just said, “He wouldn’t let us check his throat, so maybe monitor him at home for a few more days…”

The worst part? That Asian front desk.

Every receptionist I’ve encountered there had an attitude. I remember asking some questions during my earlier visits, and that Asian woman always acted like she couldn’t be bothered to answer. Once, I asked her about microchipping , she didn’t clearly explain why it was important, so I just let my stray cat get his rabies vaccine first.

Later, I found out that the rabies certificate didn’t include my cat’s microchip number. When I brought it up, she had the nerve to say:
“Oh, like I told you before to get microchipped, you know? That’s why you’re facing this issue haha.”

Excuse me??? So unprofessional. No wonder the ratings are so low. They deserve it.

I’ve been bringing my dog here for two years, but I think today has solidified that it’s time to move on to a new clinic. The actual staff are friendly and nice and approach my dog kindly, but I’ve never left the clinic in a timely manner (even after moving my schedule around to come in early on their request.)
I regularly am waiting in one of the rooms for 45+ mins. And on a few occasions have had to come out the waiting room to remind them I was still in there and had other engagements to get to.
Today my appointment was at 2, I even got there early at 1:45 and am only just leaving the clinic now at 3:20. Not sure if they’re understaffed or overbooked but unfortunately I won’t be coming back.

I was so scared and anxious when I brought my baby in. She had a serious illness that we thankfully caught in time but Dr. Chopval and her team made me feel like everything was OK again. She does for you what she would do for her animals. The receptionist is extremely well informed and gave me great advice and went over each medicine with me thoroughly. I will definitely be coming back and could not recommend them enough. Also … if this is a sign you needed, please get pet insurance.

I just got berated by the owner and another employee while sitting in my car in the emergency parking (by the way, the facility just closed).

My dog is a client here - not anymore.

Im first approached by the owner (I just parked) who asks me if I’m a client. I open the window slightly because at first I didn’t know who this guy was.

Then his employee comes to the passenger side (I’m still in the drivers seat and I lower the right window).

The employee then looks at owner to shake her head and say I’m not a client. I say, I am, and I was gonna take my dog who’s at the pup salon next door to check on her teeth after.

The employee shouts “THIS IS FOR EMERGENCIES ONLY”. Okay, got it - I’m in the wrong spot.

I tell the two caretakers no problem. I’ll move.

Owner then asks if I’m a client again. I said yes. He said thank you for being a client and then says “use your common sense” while pointing at his head.

Like I’m some kind of idiot. I had zero time to react and move my car while being berated on both sides.

Truly unpleasant experience.

This lack of professionalism was truly unsettling. If I can’t speak to the professionals who care for my family dog in a professional manner, I can’t take then seriously to care for my dog.

My husband had an extremely disappointing and frankly unsettling encounter at this veterinary office—where we have been clients in the past. He went to inquire about teeth cleaning options for our dog (who has previously been seen here), and what should have been a simple visit turned into an unnecessarily aggressive situation over a parking spot.
He parked in a space clearly marked for the Vet Office. Before he could even get out of the car, a man approached him and asked if he was a client. At the same time, the woman who is typically at the front desk (and who we've interacted with before) shouted from the other side of the car, “I didn’t see him, this is FOR EMERGENCIES ONLY BTW AND WE ARE CLOSING.” (mind you it says it’s closing at 5:30pm per yelp and this happened at 4:45pm)
The tone and delivery were uncalled for. My husband, caught off guard and beginning to feel threatened,said he would move. Despite that, the man stood closely to the car, preventing him from backing out, and muttered under his breath, “It’s common sense.”
At that point, my husband asked him not to be condescending or tell him what common sense is, which is entirely reasonable. Instead of deescalating, the woman began getting aggressive as well—all over a parking spot that is labeled for the vet office, being used by someone who had legitimate business with the vet office.
If this facility is so quick to judge and berate someone WHO IS A RETURNING CLIENT, then it’s clear the respect and professionalism we expect as clients simply isn’t there. No one deserves to be treated this way—especially not by people responsible for the care of our pets.
My husband left without entering the building, and we will not be returning. Shameful conduct.

Went for my dogs 3mo vaccination, wouldn’t give me the shot he needs because apparently she thinks 3mo and 2 weeks is better then what his last vet recommended, they also didn’t have the anti bacterial medicine she prescribed in stock, then makes me deal with amazon and chewy adding days to my dogs medicinal needs.

Tries to sell me on laser treatments for dogs ears when he only needed antibiotics.

I Gave him Bactine Max over the counter and his ears are great 👍🏻

Vet then tells me four days later they have the meds in stock if I’d like to pay $10 more than what chewy was asking… after they claimed that chewy didn’t actually request the medicine, but hours later they got it all fixed.

Approving their own prescription with chewy  would make the most sense since I’ve been waiting days, but they need that $10. Since its now 5 days plus shipping to get what my dog needs, doesn’t matter tho, will def find another vet. And for me asking for my dogs three months vaccination and to have his ears cleaned and reposted, they charged me $450 and didn’t do anything I asked for.

Bye 👋🏻
